convention: One XX per contradiction, filed by identifier with a dash. A dispute names one contradiction only, so the commander settles one thing at a time. Both sides are shown verbatim in the body. Open until the commander amends or retires a record, or answers with a CR, which is named in the generates field once settled. Numbering is global and never reused. XX-001 to XX-009 come from the reading of cockpit.constitution under CO-087. A dispute raised against a record in the truth shape carries a hyphenated name (e.g. advice-is-statement) rather than an XX id.

units.summary: CA-007 contradicts itself: one sentence says an advice unit is one file holding all its advice, another says it is a sub directory with a manifest reading each piece separately. The cockpit is built the second way.
CA-008 contradicts itself: one sentence says a commander response written inside a pilot record is immediately extracted into the record corpus, another says a response is never extracted.
CA-008 gives the extraction of the commander's words to an agent and CO-097 gives it to the pilot, which matters because the pilot's writing and reading are deliberately limited.
CA-013 says a part approval never reveals which parts are accepted, and CA-015 has the commander mark the unwanted units of a decision one by one.
Settled: the commander retired CO-109, the trial grant to write small changes with claude -p; CO-101 and CO-102 stand, the pilot does not do the work.
CO-102 and CO-109 restrict the pilot's bash while excepting claude -p; CO-089 says the pilot has no bash at all. The grep half closed when the commander amended CO-089 to grant grep.
CA-042 puts logs, manuals and teams at the top level of the cockpit; on disk they are records/logs, records/manuals and team. Either CA-042 or the rooms must move.
Settled: the commander retired CA-024 as his private note, not advice; CA-026 stands, the commander's conversation is inert and only a written record binds the pilot.
CA-006 makes an order last for its session unless promoted to a standing order, and CO-099 and CA-011 bind the pilot to every record on file. Whether an old unpromoted order still binds is unsettled.

truth-statement.truth statement 4 forbids agents from writing truth statements, but truth-advice.truth statements 5 and 6 say an advice statement is the same kind of thing in a .txt file that an agent may write, so the two records cannot both hold.

truth-record.truth statement 7 locks truth records against mutation during any build phase, but truth-advice.truth statement 9 has the advice replace the truth record during a build run, which is a mutation the lock forbids.
